svg.text: Visual implementation contract · Training Jade / Iris / Apricot · system font · data semantics remain independent
01 Color ownership · theme accents do not replace meaning
Primary actions and limited focal emphasis
Sparse warm accent and tertiary distinction
Success ≠ Jade · errors and warnings stay separate.
Theme color supports hierarchy; success, error, warning, chart, heatmap, plan, profile, gym, and nutrition colors retain their domain meaning.
02 Surface ladders · light relationships stay neutral; dark relationships stay plum / iris
Light: warm tonal canvas → low group → section → Iris selection → lifted surface.
Dark: deep plum-black canvas → lifted plum surfaces → Iris selection; Jade and Apricot stay role-specific.
03 Shape roles · visible on the route mockups
Hero scale stays rare; repeated rows and controls stay compact.
Shape signals role, not decoration. No universal capsule rule.
Scale and color share the hierarchy; weight alone does not.
Default five shown · destination count remains configurable.
1/2 done · Iris edge marks current work
Completed surfaces are quieter than the active exercise and page action.
Set completion stays compact and semantically green, separate from Jade.
Iris selection · warm lifted surface · neutral alternative.
Tonos M3E uses hierarchy, role-owned color, scale and geometry to clarify the existing workflow.
